entries.label: Alpha Guided Mission
learningObjectives: Deploy one routed glider while optional gliders may remain idle.
Place surface waypoints and configure an incoming segment dive profile.
Execute, observe depth-aware sampling, surface, and replan.
researchObjectives: Exercise the canonical mission workspace without changing scientific or scoring semantics.

entries.label: Alpha Depth Sampling Mission
learningObjectives: Compare surface, shallow, thermocline, midwater, and deep samples at the same horizontal route.
Inspect planned versus realized depth trajectory.
researchObjectives: Demonstrate that observations use actual glider x, y, z, and t rather than target-depth labels.

entries.label: Alpha Dynamic Current Mission
learningObjectives: Use the planning timeline to inspect time-varying currents.
Compare current-assisted and current-opposed route choices.
researchObjectives: Exercise depth- and time-structured current package sampling through the browser mission runtime.

entries.label: Alpha Multi-Glider Mission
learningObjectives: Assign complementary routes to two or three gliders.
Keep optional idle gliders surfaced without fabricated observations.
researchObjectives: Compare fleet assignment tradeoffs under one canonical simulator and scoring path.

entries.label: Alpha Forecast and Replanning Mission
learningObjectives: Use forecast uncertainty and observations at surfacing.
Choose whether to continue or update waypoints.
researchObjectives: Inspect deterministic seed, forecast-visible state, and public observation updates.

entries.label: Alpha Research Benchmark
learningObjectives: Inspect public benchmark data and fairness labels.
Import an external candidate plan and compare authoritative ANCHOR results.
researchObjectives: Round-trip public solver packets, benchmark bundles, notebook plans, and canonical ScoreResult provenance.
